name: Kashees Eventone Liquid Foundation | High Coverage Long Lasting Radiant Makeup Base 30 ml
description:
Kashees Eventone Liquid Foundation delivers a flawless, even-toned complexion with high coverage and all-day radiance. Its lightweight, breathable formula conceals dark spots, scars, and blemishes while offering buildable coverage from medium to full. Designed to last up to 24 hours, it ensures a smooth, natural-looking glow without feeling heavy or cakey. Suitable for all skin types, this foundation is perfect for daily wear or special occasions.
Key Features
 High coverage hides blemishes and dark spots
 Long-lasting wear up to 24 hours
 Lightweight, breathable, and non-cakey texture
 Buildable coverage from medium to full
 Smooths skin tone for flawless finish
 Suitable for daily and event makeup looks
Ingredients / Materials
Skin-safe liquid foundation base (specific formulation varies)
How to Use
 Apply a small amount with fingers, brush, or sponge
 Dot on forehead, cheeks, nose, and chin
 Blend evenly in circular or tapping motions
 Set with powder for longer wear
Package Includes
 1 × Kashees Eventone Liquid Foundation (20ml)
